comparison.objective: Repair a pipe gap with a replacement section and two staged slip couplings.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual coaxial alignment, insertion, sequencing, and coupling translation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct-size couplings close both joints; parts remain on the bench, with release and one-second stillness for full credit.
comparison.reason: Although both involve axial mechanical interaction, this tests multi-part coaxial assembly and staging, not fine rotary setting, captive-fastener relocking, or dynamic calibration.
